name: DescribeEvents

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. The default value is zh_cn. Valid values:

zh_cn: Chinese.

en_us: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh_cn。取值：
zh_cn：中文。
en_us：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the anomalous activity
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account that performed the operation that triggered the anomalous activity
parameters.help_zh: 异常事件的操作人账号ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account that handled the anomalous activity
parameters.help_zh: 异常事件的处理人账号ID
parameters.name: deal_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The processing status of the anomalous activity.

0: Unhandled.

1: Confirmed.

2: Dismissed
parameters.help_zh:
异常事件的处理状态。

0：未处理。 
1：确认违例。
2：违例排除
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The code of the parent type of the anomalous activity.

01: Anomalous permission access.

02: Anomalous data flow.

03: Anomalous data operation
parameters.help_zh:
父类型异常事件的名称。

01：权限使用异常。
02：数据流转异常。
03：数据操作异常
parameters.name: type_code

parameters.help_en:
The name of the child type of the anomalous activity.

To query anomalous activities by the child type name, call the DescribeEventTypes operation to get the name
parameters.help_zh:
子类型异常事件的名称。

如果根据子类型异常事件的名称查询异常事件列表，子类型异常事件名称可通过DescribeEventTypes接口获取
parameters.name: sub_type_code

parameters.help_en: The time when the anomalous activity occurred. This is the start time of the detection. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 异常事件发生时间，即开始检测异常事件时间。格式：时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The time when the detection of the anomalous activity ended. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 异常事件结束时间，即结束检测异常事件时间的。格式：时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 列表每页显示的数据最大条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The name of the data asset instance
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The service to which the data asset belongs. Valid values include MaxCompute, OSS, ADS, OTS, and RDS
parameters.help_zh: 数据资产表所属产品名称，取值：MaxCompute、OSS、ADS、OTS、RDS等
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The destination service for an anomalous data flow event. Valid values include MaxCompute, OSS, ADS, OTS, and RDS
parameters.help_zh: 数据流转异常类型事件中的目标产品名称，取值：MaxCompute、OSS、ADS、OTS、RDS等
parameters.name: target_product_code

parameters.help_en: The username of the RAM user
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the anomalous activity.

1: Low.

2: Medium.

3: High
parameters.help_zh:
异常事件的危险等级。
1：低危。
2：中危。
3：高危
parameters.name: warn_level
